problem_type: Generation capability aliases are projected one-for-one to the model
symptom: A normal generation request exposes nine internal generation descriptors, including separate context/create/patch/preview/read/cancel/reconcile names and gate/start transitions.
direct_cause: agentToolCatalog projects generationDescriptors directly, while generationTransportAdapters and capability registry use the same internal aliases as the model-facing vocabulary.
class_root: The model surface has no versioned semantic manifest that groups generation intent and excludes Host-only approval/effect transitions.
affected_population: All Pi model turns routed to generation
All generation aliases added to the capability registry
Approval-bearing generation requests and their Host projection
internal_only_reason: The semantic grouping, Host-only transition policy, and 50-tool count are application contracts frozen in the M0 mapping and M-line rulings.
invariants: The generation model surface contains exactly the versioned semantic plan and status intents for this slice.
Host-only request-gate, start, and decide-gate transitions never enter the model projection.
Every semantic generation operation maps to the existing canonical capability and one Host planning/effect boundary.
Legacy Pi aliases are not model-visible even when retained for internal or MCP compatibility parsing.
generality_proof: The manifest is the shared model projection boundary for the generation group; alias additions cannot become model-visible without an explicit semantic descriptor, and every checked generation caller is either translated through the manifest or remains an internal/MCP wire caller outside the Pi model surface.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own versioned semantic descriptors, capability references, risk metadata, schemas, and Host-only exclusions before runtime projection.
Translate semantic model calls to the existing lease-bound canonical generation planning seam without creating a second provider or persistence path.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The model-facing catalog is the only Pi descriptor projection and will consume the generation manifest instead of the old descriptor map.
The canonical contracts retain internal aliases as additional compatibility entries while their primary Pi aliases identify the two semantic intents.
MCP wire routes are an external compatibility/protocol surface and are not used to enumerate Pi model descriptors; they continue to resolve through the existing dispatcher.

recurrence.reason: Any future generation alias or Host transition can recreate model overload or approval leakage unless the model projection is forced through the manifest.
same_class_scan: Counted the six agentToolCatalog groups: document 6, canvas 10, timeline 14, production 10, skill 1, generation 9.
Searched all consumers of generationDescriptors, agentToolCatalog, capabilityAliasesFor, and capabilityOperationAliasesFor.
Checked nomi_request_generation_gate, nomi_start_generation, and nomi_decide_generation_gate in the Pi catalog, Host policy, generation adapter, and MCP dispatcher.

prevention.invariant: Only manifest descriptors are projected to Pi; Host-only generation transitions and unregistered aliases are omitted.
prevention.failure_mode: Duplicate semantic names, missing capability references, or overlap with Host-only names fail during manifest construction/tests; a legacy alias is not silently re-exposed.
prevention.strategy: Define one semantic descriptor per user intent, project only the manifest into agentToolCatalog, and keep internal wire compatibility below the model boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old generation descriptor module is removed from the model projection in the same slice; internal/MCP aliases are retained only below the model boundary and are not a second model projection.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The invariant is an application-level projection and Host policy contract; no third-party runtime controls alias grouping or approval ownership.

migration: No persisted data migration is needed. Existing operation, receipt, provider task, and MCP wire identifiers remain unchanged; only new Pi turns use the semantic names and the adapter translates them to the existing canonical seam.
residual_risks: The full document/canvas/timeline/production surface remains on legacy descriptors until later M2 slices.
C9 generationAi* store-field deletion remains intentionally blocked by the deconstruction handoff red light.
ProductionRun legacy-playbook writer retirement remains an M2 red-light target and is not changed by this projection slice.
